goals.text: AbBill gains only additive nullable/defaulted columns (lines, payments, postingMode, partial/draft) so existing bills and cash-basis tenants keep their rows and pay-time behaviour unchanged.
AbBillLine and AbBillPayment (children) are in the tenant export and deletion registry, deleted before AbBill.

launch.docsNone: Schema-only PR: no user-facing or developer docs changed; bills/employee docs landed with PRs 3bc/4b and #645.
launch.rollback: Revert the PR. The added columns and tables are additive and nullable/defaulted; they stay in the database unused and existing bills are untouched.
